$comment: Synthetic path-encoding cases for T18/T19 (not schema fixtures). 'expected' is the current C behavior; F-T11-xx marks a finding candidate.

cases.name: Garage Cam
cases.expected: resolves to 'Garage Cam' (legacy name; new names cannot contain spaces)

cases.name: Garage Cam
cases.expected: also resolves to 'Garage Cam': path decoding maps '+' to space

cases.name: a+b
cases.expected: resolves to 'a b' (wrong stream / 404) because '+' decodes to space

cases.name: lobby/east
